segments.text: Name
vfs_commit — flush dirty data at specified intervals
Synopsis
DESCRIPTION
This VFS module is part of the [[p0]] suite.
The [[p0]] VFS module keeps track of the amount of data written to a file and synchronizes it to disk when a specified amount accumulates.

[[p0]] is useful in two circumstances. First, if you have very precious data, the impact of unexpected power loss can be minimized by a small commit:dthresh value. Secondly, write performance can be improved on some systems by flushing file data early and at regular intervals.
This module is stackable.
OPTIONS
commit:dthresh = BYTES
Synchronize file data each time the specified number of bytes has been written.
The following suffixes may be applied to BYTES:
[[p0]] - BYTES is a number of kilobytes
[[p0]] - BYTES is a number of megabytes
[[p0]] - BYTES is a number of gigabytes
EXAMPLES
Synchronize the file data on the [precious] share after every 512 kilobytes (524288 bytes) of data is written:
CAVEATS
On some systems, the data synchronization performed by [[p0]] may reduce performance.
VERSION
This man page is part of version 4.25.0 of the Samba suite.
